test_MaxIoUAssigner: test the MaxIoUAssigner to assign predicted bboxes to ground truth bboxes using IoU thresholds
test_PointAssigner: test the PointAssigner to assign predicted points to ground truth bboxes based on point-in-box logic
test_ApproxMaxIoUAssigner: test the ApproxMaxIoUAssigner to assign approximate bboxes to ground truth using octave-based IoU matching
test_CenterRegionAssigner: test the CenterRegionAssigner to assign bboxes to ground truth using center region positive and negative scales
test_HungarianAssigner: test the HungarianAssigner to perform optimal bipartite matching between predictions and ground truth using cost matrices
